race.description: Bodalla Pub - Best Pub In Bodalla Hcp (C1)
race.comment: MRS FLANDERS (2) bolted in over this track and trip last time out in a dominant display from the front, winning by 6L. Tougher here, but this shapes similarly and the last start figure stacks up. Can repeat the dose in a very suitable assignment. MINKS WRITTEN (8) comes here off an 85-day freshen after failing in heavy going at Wagga before the break. She'd turned in some solid performances prior to that at the booking of Boudvillain is a good push for her chances. She was a winner first-up last campaign and can return on a positive note again. MELODIA PERFECTA (7) can be in the finish if she brings her best form. TASSALINA (4) can play a leading role on resumption.
